name: Bartholomew Schriefer
notes: Born in Germany; aged 60 in the 1900 census at 2531 E. Oliver Street, Baltimore.
Children on Find a Grave: Mary (1883–1937), Jennie Katherine (Frank, 1889–1955), Anna M. (Herbert, 1892–1967), Margaret M. (Conroy, 1896–1961), George (1899–1951) and Henry (1904–1980).
